entries.german: Eberhard von Rosenberg und seine Ehefrau Irmtraut (Irmendrut) verkaufen auf Wiederkauf Kloster Schöntal (Schönntal) um 90 lb hl ihre Mühle gen. die Hohe Mühle (Hohe Mül), also die der Burg Rosenberg zunächst gelegene Mühle, und ihre unmittelbar danach an der Kirnau (an demselben bache) zwischen Sindolsheim (Sindoltshein) und Rosenberg gelegene Mühle, die zuvor Eberhard Rüdt (Rude), Ritter, innehatte. Bürgen: 1) Arnold von Rosenberg, 2) Herr Konrad von Rossriet (Rosseriet), 3) Herr Dieter (Dyetrichen) von Berlichingen (Berlichen), [alle] Ritter, und 4) Hermann von Berlichingen Super molendinum, quod dicitur Hohemul iuxta castrum Roßenberg et super molendinum situm infra Sindeltzhein et et Roßenberg
entries.english: Eberhard von Rosenberg and his wife Irmtraut sell their mill, called the Hohe Mühle, the mill located next to Rosenberg Castle, and their mill located immediately adjacent to it on the Kirnau (on the same stream) between Sindolsheim and Rosenberg, which was previously held by Eberhard Rüdt, Ritter, to Schöntal Abbey for 90 lb hl.  Guardians: 1) Arnold von Rosenberg, 2) Lord Konrad von Rossriet, 3) Lord Diether von Berlichingen, [all] Ritter, and 4) Hermann von Berlichingen  Above the mill, which is called Hohemul, next to the castle of Rosenberg and above the mill located below Sindeltzhein and Rosenberg

facts.content: with his wife Irmtraut, sold the Hohe Mühle beside Rosenberg Castle to Schöntal Abbey.
with his wife Irmtraut, sold another mill on the Kirnau between Sindolsheim and Rosenberg to Schöntal Abbey.
acted as a surety for the sale.
